user.title: RAPT Brewing Session Manager
user.description: Choose how this integration should receive RAPT Pill data.

bluetooth_select.title: RAPT Pill - Direct Bluetooth
bluetooth_select.description: Select a RAPT Pill discovered via Bluetooth, or enter a device address manually. Found {devices_count} RAPT device(s).

bluetooth_manual.title: RAPT Pill - Manual Address
bluetooth_manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth address of your RAPT Pill (e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).

bluetooth_confirm.title: RAPT Pill Discovered
bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to add the RAPT Pill at {address} to Home Assistant?

entity.title: RAPT Pill - Home Assistant entities
entity.description: Pick the existing sensor entities that expose your RAPT Pill data (e.g. from a Shelly BLE proxy).

cloud.title: RAPT Cloud
cloud.description: Sign in with your RAPT portal account. Create an API secret under Account → API Secrets at app.rapt.io.

cloud_device.title: RAPT Cloud - Select Hydrometer
cloud_device.description: Found {devices_count} hydrometer(s) on your RAPT account.

reconfigure_bluetooth.title: Reconfigure RAPT Pill
reconfigure_bluetooth.description: Update the Bluetooth address of this RAPT Pill.

reconfigure_entity.title: Reconfigure Source Entities
reconfigure_entity.description: Update the Home Assistant entities used as the RAPT Pill data source.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed; check your email and API secret
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the RAPT cloud
error.no_hydrometers: No hydrometers found on this RAPT account
error.no_devices_found: No RAPT devices found via Bluetooth. Ensure your RAPT Pill is powered on and nearby, then try again.

init.title: RAPT Brewing Options
init.description: What would you like to configure?

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Configure where brewing alerts are sent. Available services: {notification_services}

alerts.title: Alert thresholds
alerts.description: Tune when brewing alerts fire and when the device counts as offline.

display.title: Display & calibration
display.description: Choose the gravity display unit and apply calibration offsets to raw readings. Note: the Target/Original Gravity input boxes always use SG.

entities.title: Source entities
entities.description: Update the Home Assistant sensor entities used as the RAPT Pill data source.
